unit.why: A single narrative: on Shavuot R. S. finds the stove tile and chair trembling, and the Rav explains that the Besht and the Maggid had visited him and approved his Torah.

stories.start_quote: פעם אחד בא אליו הר"ש הנ"ל
stories.summary_en: On Shavuot R. S. finds a stove tile and the Rav's chair trembling; the Rav explains that the departed Besht and his master the Maggid had visited him, that he spoke Torah he had received from the Maggid, that a heavenly voice resounded, and that the Besht confirmed it and both blessed him.

tags.why: The story is set on Shavuot.

quotes: כי היום היה אצלי הבעש"ט הקדוש ומורי הרב המגיד
tags.why: The departed Besht and Maggid appear to him while awake.

quotes: ואח"כ דברו עמי ועשו מה שעשו וברכו אותי
tags.why: He converses with the souls of dead tzaddikim.
A supernatural disclosure, including a voice from heaven.

quotes: הכסא אשר ישב עליה הרב רועדת
tags.why: Objects tremble as a supernatural sign of the visitation.

quotes: ואמרתי להם מאמר מה שקבלתי ממורי על ההפטורה
tags.why: He delivers a Torah discourse on the haftarah.

quotes: תורתו אמת כי כן קבלת מפי אות באות
tags.why: The chain of transmission from Besht to Maggid to the Rav is central.

quotes: רק מאשר ראיתי כי נכנס קודם למורי הבנתי כי הוא הבעש״ט
tags.why: He identifies the unfamiliar Besht by inference.
The trembling objects are a wondrous sign.

quotes: ויאמר לו הרב כי היום היה אצלי
tags.why: The Rav recounts the event to R. S.

missing_concepts: visitation by souls of departed tzaddikim
heavenly approval of a teaching / authenticity of transmitted Torah
